dedupe_keys.name: agricultural machinery stocks in 337 chinese cities 1978 2020 weight and embodied materials

description: A table of 43,473 records giving the total weight of agricultural machinery in stock, and its split into three embodied material types, for 337 cities from 1978 to 2020. The figshare record names ten creators, Xiang Li, Lulu Song, Qiance Liu, Xin Ouyang, Ting Mao, Haojie Lu, Litao Liu, Xiaojie Liu, Wei-Qiang Chen and Gang Liu, and was posted on 18 April 2023 as version 1. It is a single downloadable Excel file of about 0.77 MB, free under CC0 1.0. The page read does not name the country or the three materials; the sister industrial machinery record from the same collection covers 337 Chinese cities, so this is taken to be China (inferred). Coverage is 337 cities over 43 years. Caveats: stocks are modelled from statistics, not counted, the material types are not listed in the description read, and machinery counts by class are not given. For simulation it gives the size and growth of the farm machinery fleet by city, to estimate mechanisation capacity and fuel demand in agriculture, the equipment exposed to floods, and the material stock for circular economy scenarios. A related catalogue record is the industrial machinery stocks in 337 cities, 1978-2020.
